headline: Infineon Commits €1.1bn to Villach GaN Program
deck: The Austrian site is intended for high-volume 300 mm gallium-nitride power-semiconductor production, with a planned end-2027 start.
body: Infineon has committed €1.1 billion to build a new manufacturing facility at its Villach site in Austria, Reuters reported. DPA, in a report published by Welt, also said the investment is for a new facility at the Austrian site. [E1][E2]
Infineon says the facility is intended to be the world's first high-volume production site for next-generation power semiconductors based on 300 mm gallium-nitride wafers. [E3]
Production is planned for the end of next year, while the investments are to continue through 2034. [E4]
